pages.text: Two bamboo baskets sat on the bank. They looked exactly alike. One held rice to eat, and the other held seeds.
Dingding shook them. Only the seed basket rustled. "I'm hungry. Let's eat soon!"
Mom carried a basket in each hand. "I'll put them down in a moment."
On the way, Mom opened a water channel. She switched the baskets from one hand to the other.
Mom set both baskets on the bank. "The rice is on the right."
From far below, Mom called, "Wait, was it the left?" She was already too far away.
Dingding looked at the two identical baskets. Dingding's tummy rumbled.
Dingding shook each basket in turn. Only one of them rustled.
Dingding opened the quiet basket. Warm steam rose from the rice.
The ducks lined up in front of the seed basket. Mom hurried over and shut the lid. "That's not your food!"
